segments.name: Product testing
segments.description: Develops and commercializes AI-driven epigenetic and genetic clinical blood tests for cardiovascular disease risk assessment and detection.
segments.evidence: the Company has determined that the Company has one operating segment (product testing) as defined by ASC Topic 280 "Segment Reporting".

revenueModel.text: Provider organizations, patients, and employers pay for cardiovascular blood tests, generally charged for tests utilized for the minimum committed test volume with pricing varying by organization type, size and volume.
revenueModel.evidence: The tests can be paid for by provider organizations, patients, and/or employers.
